evidence.title: Fable 5. - by Ruben Hassid - How to AI

name: Fable 5
summary: Guide to using Claude Fable-5 without burning money: model families, per-token costs, and when the expensive model is worth it.
description: An instalment of the How to AI newsletter on Claude Fable-5, the smartest and most expensive Claude tier. It maps the Claude model families (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus, Mythos, Fable-5), explains what smarter AI costs per token and per turn, and gives rules for when to use Fable-5 and when not to. Later sections cover connecting Fable to everything, Claude Cowork, Claude Code, a /fable-prompter command and keeping a team brain in a folder.
